name: mod
description: Staff moderation: warn, mute, kick, ban - with case logging.
short: Staff moderation tools: warn, mute, kick, ban, and case tracking.
endUserDataStatement: Stores user IDs in moderation case records, warnings, active punishments, and staff notes. Target user IDs are anonymized upon GDPR erasure while preserving audit integrity; staff notes about the user are deleted.

configFields.label: Mod Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel where moderation action embeds are posted.

configFields.label: Quarantine Role
configFields.description: Role assigned when a member is quarantined (replaces all their roles).

configFields.label: Warn Thresholds
configFields.description: JSON map of warn count → action. E.g. {"3":{"action":"mute","duration":"1h"},"5":{"action":"ban"}}

configFields.label: Max Targets Per Command
configFields.description: How many members a single mod command (ban, kick, mute, quarantine, etc.) can target at once, e.g. `,mute @a @b @c`.

configFields.label: Predefined Reasons
configFields.description: Common punishment reasons to suggest as autocomplete on the reason field, one per line.

configFields.label: Immune Role IDs
configFields.description: Role IDs exempt from automated escalation (heat timeouts/quarantine, anti-nuke responses, warn-threshold auto-actions). Manual staff commands (/ban, /warn, etc.) always work regardless.

configFields.label: Duplicate Case Window (minutes)
configFields.description: Before opening a new case, warn staff if a similar case against the same member was opened within this many minutes. 0 disables the check.
